'''Alex Tennet The Terror of Tatooine''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Alex Tennet]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds30.htm The Terror of Tatooine], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228002739/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ds30.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Alex Tennet]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
